tree: Build automated workflows visually — no coding needed.
Create powerful workflows without coding. Save time, reduce manual work and keep your business running smoothly.

tree.aria-label: Noxtill workflow builder canvas showing a New Lead Welcome workflow: new lead added, check source, send welcome email, then create task, add tag and assign owner

tree: A workflow builder lets you connect a trigger to a series of actions on a visual canvas. Noxtill runs those steps for you every time, so routine work happens the same way without manual effort.
Repeating the same steps by hand for every lead, booking or message takes time and steps get missed.
Build the steps once on the canvas. Noxtill runs them automatically each time the trigger fires.
Workflow automation software: each row is one workflow built on the canvas.
Use a simple drag-and-drop builder to automate your communication and business processes.
Create workflows for WhatsApp, Email, SMS, Instagram and Messenger — all in one place.
Every Noxtill automation is built here. A workflow can start from an event, a schedule or a webhook, and its actions reach customers through your inboxes and records.
How Workflow Builder works in Noxtill, and where to check
How can a small business build automated workflows?

Start from a ready-made template or a blank canvas in Noxtill's visual workflow builder, choose a trigger, add actions and conditions, then turn it on. As a workflow automation platform for small business teams, it runs across your channels without code.
How does Workflow Builder software help a small business, and what should buyers evaluate?

It takes repetitive steps off your team, cuts manual errors and keeps work moving. When comparing a no code workflow automation tool, a business process workflow builder or drag and drop workflow automation, check available triggers and actions, templates, channel coverage, testing and run history.
